subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should this issue stay open as a vLLM Usage-page repro request, be folded into the unknown-pricing work, or be closed later if the reporter cannot provide current-main artifacts?
rationale: Current main has the intended vLLM streaming usage and Usage aggregation paths, but the report lacks the artifacts needed to tell whether the remaining behavior is a code bug, a pricing-policy gap, or an outdated/incomplete setup.

options.title: Keep open for focused evidence
options.body: Ask for raw vLLM SSE output, transcript usage, sessions.usage and usage.cost responses, a Usage-page screenshot, and model cost config from a current build before choosing a fix.

options.title: Fold cost-only cases into pricing work
options.body: If the artifacts show token counts but missing/unknown costs, treat the cost question as covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 and keep this issue only for the blank-page symptom if still present.

options.title: Close later for insufficient repro
options.body: If no current-main artifacts arrive after the stale window, close as insufficient information rather than as implemented.

recommendation.title: Keep open for focused evidence
recommendation.body: Ask for raw vLLM SSE output, transcript usage, sessions.usage and usage.cost responses, a Usage-page screenshot, and model cost config from a current build before choosing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The usage-cost foundation and vLLM/local streaming-usage compat history both route through this area of work.
